title: Q2 reliability review — notification-service
description:
Per-service reliability review for notification-service, covering the Q2 metrics window (metrics_export_q2.csv: weeks 2024-04-01 through 2024-06-24). The reliability lead is working through the services one at a time ahead of the annual roll-up; this is the notification-service one.

Standard shape for these reviews:

1. Platform figures for the window as the reporting tool computes them, against each target in docs/sla_commitments.md. The metrics export is platform-wide rather than per-service, so the platform figures go in as the context the service ran in.
2. The service section: the incidents recorded against notification-service inside the window, each with its date, duration and affected-user count, from monitoring/incident_log.json. affected_services is the field that says which service an incident sits against.
3. Where the service stood at the end of the window.

Build it with scripts/generate_status_report.sh. Deliverable: reports/notification_service_reliability_q2.md.

Out of window: anything dated outside the Q2 metrics export. That includes the January 2025 notification-service deploy regression (INC-2025-0114-001), which is tracked on its own ticket and does not belong in this review.
scope: Read-only synthesis of monitoring data into reports/notification_service_reliability_q2.md. No changes to monitoring data, incident records, dashboards, or service configuration.
